umbra_registration_umbra_minus_osm.compare: A2 (stands.md s.2) +3.44 m E on 6 full-resolution bands; the former taxiway Huber fit (+6.14 E, -0.89 N) is kept only as a diagnostic
umbra_registration_umbra_minus_osm.single_value_note: this is the single Phase-1 Umbra registration (tools/common/umbra_reg.py), applied by twy_refit, stand_sar, stands_plates and sar_registration
